passages.title: Email
passages.body:
To: Daniel Ortiz
From: Priya Nair
Date: September 12
Subject: Supplier visit

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for agreeing to host our team at your factory on October 4. We would like to tour the packaging line in the morning and meet with your quality manager after lunch. Five people will attend: myself, two engineers, and two members of our purchasing team. Could you let me know whether a conference room will be available from 1:30 P.M.? We would also appreciate a list of the safety equipment visitors must wear.

If the date needs to change, please tell me before September 20 so that we can rebook our flights.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
Procurement Director, Halden Foods

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To arrange a visit to a factory

fr.rule: L'objet du message se trouve généralement dans la première phrase : ici, remercier pour l'accueil de l'équipe à l'usine le 4 octobre.
why_wrong: A : le voyage est maintenu, seule une modification de date est envisagée.
C : Daniel est déjà un fournisseur, ce n'est pas une annonce.
fr.example: I am writing to arrange a meeting next week.

en.rule: The purpose is usually in the first sentence: here, thanking Daniel for hosting the team at the factory on October 4.
why_wrong: A: the trip is going ahead; only a date change is considered.
C: Daniel is already a supplier; nothing is announced.
en.example: I am writing to arrange a meeting next week.

questions.stem: What does Ms. Nair ask Mr. Ortiz to provide?
choices: A list of required safety equipment

fr.rule: Question de détail : repérer la demande explicite. « a list of the safety equipment visitors must wear ».
why_wrong: B : ce sont ses propres vols, qu'elle réservera elle-même.
fr.example: We would appreciate a copy of the agenda.

en.rule: Detail question: find the explicit request. 'a list of the safety equipment visitors must wear'.
why_wrong: B: she handles her own flights.
en.example: We would appreciate a copy of the agenda.

questions.stem: What is suggested about Halden Foods?
choices: It sends employees from several departments.
It has a factory in another country.
It has finished its quality inspection.
It owns the factory Ms. Nair will visit.

fr.rule: Inférence : combiner les informations. Le groupe comprend des ingénieurs et des membres du service achats, donc plusieurs services.
why_wrong: B : rien n'indique un autre pays (les vols peuvent être nationaux).
C : l'inspection qualité aura lieu après le déjeuner, elle n'est pas terminée.
D : l'usine appartient à Daniel (le fournisseur).
fr.example: Two engineers and two buyers will attend, so several teams are involved.

en.rule: Inference: combine details. The group includes engineers and purchasing staff, so several departments.
why_wrong: B: nothing shows another country (flights could be domestic).
C: the quality meeting is planned after lunch, so it is not finished.
D: the factory belongs to Daniel, the supplier.
en.example: Two engineers and two buyers will attend, so several teams are involved.
